explanation.en: The flat panel on the roof, “known as the collector”, is the lower left part of the diagram. Answer: collector; “on the roof” is already labelled.
explanation.kk: Шатырдағы жалпақ панель, «known as the collector», — сызбаның сол жақ төменгі бөлігі. Жауап collector; «on the roof» жазылған.
explanation.ru: Плоская панель на крыше, «known as the collector», — нижняя левая часть схемы. Ответ collector; «on the roof» уже подписано.

RT-AC-DL-02-Q1.quote: a flat panel on the roof, known as the collector

explanation.en: “thin copper pipes painted black” → black. The colour helps absorb heat.
explanation.kk: «thin copper pipes painted black» → black. Қара түс жылуды көбірек сіңіреді.
explanation.ru: «thin copper pipes painted black» → black. Цвет помогает поглощать тепло.

RT-AC-DL-02-Q2.quote: thin copper pipes painted black to absorb as much heat as possible

explanation.en: The tank is higher than the collector, “in the attic” → attic. The “roof” is where the panel is.
explanation.kk: Бак коллектордан жоғары, «in the attic» тұрады → attic. «Roof» — бактың емес, панельдің орны.
explanation.ru: Бак стоит выше коллектора, «in the attic» → attic. «Roof» — место панели, а не бака.

RT-AC-DL-02-Q3.quote: The tank is usually placed higher than the collector, in the attic

explanation.en: “Cold water enters the collector at its lowest point” → point. Take the word after “lowest” from the text.
explanation.kk: «Cold water enters the collector at its lowest point» → point. «lowest» сөзінен кейінгі сөзді мәтіннен аламыз.
explanation.ru: «Cold water enters the collector at its lowest point» → point. Слово после «lowest» берём из текста.

RT-AC-DL-02-Q4.quote: Cold water enters the collector at its lowest point

explanation.en: “an electric element inside the tank” → element. A “pump” is mentioned only as not needed.
explanation.kk: «an electric element inside the tank» → element. «Pump» аталады, бірақ ол жоқ: «no pump is needed».
explanation.ru: «an electric element inside the tank» → element. «Pump» упомянут, но его как раз нет: «no pump is needed».

RT-AC-DL-02-Q5.quote: an electric element inside the tank can heat the water
